scope: Synthetic Chromium pages only; no account or live ChatGPT access; no private renderer or retention invocation.

measurement.extensionExecution: real CDP isolated world with mocked chrome APIs; main-world probe has no controller access
measurement.gc: fixture comparisons record metrics before and after two explicit CDP collections; probe itself never forces GC
measurement.nativeModel: independent measured-height virtual list with optional containing-range hysteresis; not ChatGPT's production renderer
measurement.memoryMeaning: CDP JS/embedder metrics and DOM counters are partial measurements, cannot be summed into RSS or total tab memory
